content: To analyze the linguistic structure of the inquiry-response pairs in the entire 41-hour dataset, we randomly sampled a seed dataset consisting of 1,200 turns and manually categorized them to different types, which are summarized in Table TABREF14 along with the corresponding occurrence frequency statistics. Note that each given utterance could be categorized to more than one type. We elaborate on each utterance type below.
